g.text: - Carrier PCB for a SOCKETED ESP32 development board (provisional: Espressif ESP32-DevKitC V4, classic ESP32, 38-pin).

g.desc: - Carrier PCB for a SOCKETED ESP32 development board (provisional: Espressif ESP32-DevKitC V4, classic ESP32, 38-pin).

g.text: - Three externally supplied low-voltage DC inputs, each a separate removable isolation point:

g.desc: - Three externally supplied low-voltage DC inputs, each a separate removable isolation point:

g.text: VIN_LOGIC (J1, 12 V nominal) -> protection -> 5 V module -> +5V / DevKitC 5V

g.desc: VIN_LOGIC (J1, 12 V nominal) -> protection -> 5 V module -> +5V / DevKitC 5V

g.text: PUMP_VIN (J2, 12 V nominal) -> fuse -> pump connector, low-side MOSFET switch with hardware default-OFF

g.desc: PUMP_VIN (J2, 12 V nominal) -> fuse -> pump connector, low-side MOSFET switch with hardware default-OFF

g.text: SERVO_VIN (J4, per servo) -> fuse -> servo connector; PWM buffered 3.3 V -> 5 V

g.desc: SERVO_VIN (J4, per servo) -> fuse -> servo connector; PWM buffered 3.3 V -> 5 V

g.text: - No mains voltage on the PCB. Generator power does not pass through the PCB (sense connections only).

g.desc: - No mains voltage on the PCB. Generator power does not pass through the PCB (sense connections only).

g.text: - Measurement: generator voltage sense + external generator current sensor interface (analog or I2C),

g.desc: - Measurement: generator voltage sense + external generator current sensor interface (analog or I2C),
